package.name: okvis_apps
package.description: OKVIS2-X dataset apps as a colcon target (mow-e T-0113). The app binaries (okvis_app_synchronous, okvis2x_app_synchronous, dbow2_test) are compiled by the okvis superbuild (BUILD_APPS=ON) because they link non-exported superbuild targets (SRL::Supereight2); this package anchors the dependency so `--packages-up-to okvis_apps` builds them, and installs the helper scripts.
